name: GitLab
label: GitLab REST API v4
description: GitLab REST API v4 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/. Operations: project_get, project_list, file_get, file_create, file_update, file_delete, issue_create, issue_get, issue_update, issue_note, mr_create, mr_get, mr_update, mr_accept, pipeline_create, pipeline_get, job_cancel, job_retry, release_create, branch_create, tag_create, listen. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: project_get | project_list | file_get | file_create | file_update | file_delete | issue_create | issue_get | issue_update | issue_note | mr_create | mr_get | mr_update | mr_accept | pipeline_create | pipeline_get | job_cancel | job_retry | release_create | branch_create | tag_create | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_get'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Project id or URL-encoded namespace/path. Required for project-scoped ops.

schema.label: iid
schema.description: Project-level issue or MR iid (not global id).

schema.label: file_path
schema.description: Repository file path. Encoded including slashes.

schema.label: ref
schema.description: Branch, tag, or SHA.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Repository file payload for file_create / file_update (encoding=text|base64). For issue_create/issue_update use `description`; for issue_note use `body` (this field is copied when those are omitted). For branch_create / tag_create agents may place the new branch or tag name here.

schema.label: membership
schema.description: Query-string parameter `membership` for operation: project_list.

schema.label: search
schema.description: Query-string parameter `search` for operation: project_list.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operation: project_list.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operation: project_list.

schema.label: branch
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `branch` for operations: file_create, file_update, file_delete, branch_create.

schema.label: commit_message
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `commit_message` for operations: file_create, file_update, file_delete.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Request-body parameter `title` for operations: issue_create, issue_update, mr_create, mr_update.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: issue_create, issue_update, mr_create, mr_update, release_create.

schema.label: labels
schema.description: Request-body parameter `labels` for operations: issue_create, issue_update.

schema.label: state_event
schema.description: Request-body parameter `state_event` for operations: issue_update, mr_update.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Issue note markdown for issue_note. Official GitLab `body` (the note text, not a generic blob). Max 1,000,000 characters. Example: Ship it after QA.

schema.label: source_branch
schema.description: Request-body parameter `source_branch` for operation: mr_create.

schema.label: target_branch
schema.description: Request-body parameter `target_branch` for operation: mr_create.

schema.label: pipeline_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `pipeline_id` for operation: pipeline_get. Required by: pipeline_get.

schema.label: job_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `job_id` for operations: job_cancel, job_retry. Required by: job_cancel, job_retry.

schema.label: tag_name
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `tag_name` for operations: release_create, tag_create.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Request-body parameter `name` for operation: release_create.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Query-string parameter `message` for operation: tag_create.

schema.label: internal
schema.description: When true, issue_note is an internal (confidential) note. Official `internal`. Overrides deprecated confidential.

schema.label: created_at
schema.description: ISO-8601 created time for issue_note (owner/admin only). Example: 2016-03-11T03:45:40Z.

schema.label: encoding
schema.description: file_create / file_update content encoding. EXACT: text | base64. Default text.

schema.label: author_email
schema.description: Optional commit author email for file_create / file_update.

schema.label: author_name
schema.description: Optional commit author name for file_create / file_update.

schema.label: assignee_id
schema.description: User id to assign on issue_create. Official assignee_id.

schema.label: milestone_id
schema.description: Milestone id on issue_create. Official milestone_id.

schema.label: confidential
schema.description: When true, issue_create makes a confidential issue.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: project_get, project_list, file_get, file_create, file_update, file_delete, issue_create, issue_get, issue_update, issue_note, mr_create, mr_get, mr_update, mr_accept, pipeline_create, pipeline_get, job_cancel, job_retry, release_create, branch_create, tag_create, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: GitLab personal, project, or group access token. Sent as PRIVATE-TOKEN. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: id
configurationParameters.description: Default GitLab project id or URL-encoded path when INPUT id is empty. Example: group%2Fproject.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: GitLab Secret Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header X-Gitlab-Token. Never logged.
